accessDis: Umuyobozi ushinzwe imyitwarire abona amakuru y'imyitwarire n'ay'amacumbi.
accessDos: Umuyobozi w'Amasomo acunga gahunda, amanota n'inyandiko z'amasomo.
accessNote: Aya mabwiriza ashyirwa mu bikorwa kuri seriveri, ntabwo ari uguhisha gusa ku rubuga. Ibikorwa by'ubuyobozi byihariye byandikwa mu gitabo cy'igenzura cyerekana uwakoze iki n'igihe.
changesBody: Iyi nyandiko niyo ihinduka mu buryo bufatika, ibigo bikoresha Imboni birabimenyeshwa. Gukomeza kuyikoresha nyuma y'impinduka bisobanura kuyemera uko yavuguruwe.
childrenBody: Ibyinshi Imboni ibika bireba abana bato, kandi birimo ibyiciro byoroshye guhungabana ahantu hose: ubuzima n'amateka y'imyitwarire. Tubifata nk'imbogamizi nyayo. Aho guhitamo mu iyubakwa bihitamo hagati y'ubworoherane n'ugushyira ahagaragara inyandiko y'umunyeshuri, duhitamo icyoroshye gike.
closing: Iyi nyandiko isobanura imikorere ya tekiniki n'iy'imitunganyirize. Si inama y'ubwunganizi mu mategeko, kandi ntisimbura politiki y'ibanga ikigo cyawe gisabwa gutangariza ababyeyi.
holdsBody: Imboni ibika ibyo ikigo gikeneye kugira ngo gikore: amazina n'aho abanyeshuri, ababyeyi n'abakozi baboneka; amakuru y'amasomo arimo amanota, kwitabira n'imikoro; amakuru y'ubuzima nk'ubwoko bw'amaraso, ibibatera allergie n'indwara; amakuru y'imyitwarire n'ay'amacumbi; n'uko amafaranga y'ishuri ahagaze. Amagambo y'ibanga ntabikwa na rimwe, hakabikwa gusa ibimenyetso byayo bidasubira inyuma.
intro: Iyi paji isobanura uko Imboni ikora nk'utanga iyi porogaramu. Buri kigo gikoresha Imboni ni cyo gishinzwe amakuru y'abanyeshuri bacyo, kandi ni cyo gitangaza politiki yacyo y'ibanga ku babyeyi. Niba uri umubyeyi cyangwa umunyeshuri, saba iy'ikigo cyawe.
isolationBody: Buri kigo gihabwa ahacyo bwite muri banki y'amakuru. Ibigo bibiri ntibisangira imbonerahamwe kandi ntibitandukanywa n'akayunguruzo ko muri porogaramu kashobora kwibeshya. Ikibazo gikoreshwa n'ikigo kimwe ntigishobora kugarura imirongo y'ikindi kigo, kuko iyo mirongo itari mu mbonerahamwe gisoma.
isolationTitle: Ibigo bitandukanywa ku rwego rwa banki y'amakuru
notCollectBody: Uburyo bwacu bwo gukurikirana amakosa bwashyizweho kutigera bufata amakuru bwite. Amanota, inyandiko z'ubuvuzi, iz'imyitwarire, ibirimo mu byifuzo, aderesi za imeyili n'ibimenyetso byo kwinjira ntibishyirwa muri raporo z'amakosa, bityo ntibyoherezwa hanze igihe hari ikigenda nabi. Ibi ni icyemezo cyafashwe, si uko byari bisanzwe.
notSell: Ntitugurisha amakuru bwite, kandi ntitwayakoresha mu kwamamaza cyangwa gusesengura imyirondoro.
protectBackup: Banki y'amakuru ibikwa ku bundi buryo buri joro.
protectHash: Amagambo y'ibanga abikwa mu buryo budasubira inyuma, ntashobora kugarurwa.
protectThrottle: Kwinjira byanze kenshi bigabanyirizwa umuvuduko kugira ngo hatagira ukeka ijambo ry'ibanga.
protectTls: Amakuru yose yohererezwa ari mu ibanga rya TLS.
protectTwoFactor: Kwemeza mu ntambwe ebyiri birahari kuri konti z'abakozi.
retentionBody: Ibigo ni byo byifatira icyemezo cy'igihe bibika inyandiko, bikurikije inshingano zabyo mu mategeko. Imboni itanga uburyo bwo gusiba amakuru kugira ngo ikigo gishobore gukuraho amakuru bwite y'umuntu igihe atagikenewe cyangwa igihe hatanzwe icyifuzo cyemewe.
rightsBody: Ibyifuzo byo kubona, gukosora cyangwa gusiba amakuru bwite bishyikirizwa ikigo gifite izo nyandiko, kuko ari cyo kizishinzwe. Niba utazi uwo wavugana na we, cyangwa ikigo cyawe kidashobora kugufasha,
rightsBodyEnd: tuzayoborera icyifuzo cyawe aho kigomba kujya.
subtitle: Uko Imboni ifata amakuru ibigo biduha byizeye.
title: Ibanga n'irinda ry'amakuru
translationNotice: Iyi ni ubuhinduzi. Igihe habaye ukutumvikana hagati y'indimi, inyandiko y'Icyongereza ni yo ifite agaciro.
